Interface IBlock

Namespace
Koffing.Blocks
Assembly
Koffing.dll

Interface of static methods used to work with Blocks.

public interface IBlock

Remarks

Note that because these are static abstract methods, the new keyword will have to be used on overrides. This also requires calling the correct method through reflection, but for the most part, the code to do that is already part of the Block abstract class implementation.

Methods

GetHashCodeBasis()

Get the hash code basis representing this block type, which will be exponentiated as a part of calculating GetHashCode().

public static abstract int GetHashCodeBasis()

Returns

int

The basis to use when calculating hash codes for this block type.

Remarks

The number returned here should be a unique prime number among all derived Koffing.Blocks to ensure proper hashing. The current set of numbers is verified in GetBlockHashCodeIsCorrect(Block, int).
